test.create_query: CREATE TABLE r (k UInt64, k2 UInt32, s String, lc LowCardinality(String), c UInt32, t UInt32, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory

CREATE TABLE l ( x UInt64, t UInt32, k UInt64, k2 UInt32, s String, lc LowCardinality(String), nk Nullable(UInt64), nk2 Nullable(UInt32), kn UInt64, k2n UInt32, sn String, lcn LowCardinality(String), nkn Nullable(UInt64), nk2n Nullable(UInt32) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO r SELECT intDiv(number, 4) AS k, intHash32(k), toString(k), toString(k), 5, toUInt32(number % 4), number FROM numbers(80000)

INSERT INTO l SELECT number, toUInt32(number % 4), a, intHash32(a), toString(a), toString(a), a, intHash32(a), an, intHash32(an), toString(an), toString(an), an, intHash32(an) FROM (SELECT number, intHash64(number) % 20000 AS a, (a + 1) % 20000 AS an FROM numbers_mt(4709448)) SETTINGS max_block_size = 65409, max_insert_block_size = 65409, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(l.x, r.v)) FROM (SELECT *, 5 AS c FROM l) AS l LEFT JOIN r AS r ON {keys} AND l.t <= r.t
